newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $25 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $25 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Feb 3.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $25 billion of three- and six-month bills on Feb 3 to pay down $2.325 billion as $27.32 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on Feb 6. The three-month bills mature on May 8 and the six-month bills mature on Aug 7.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127944H4 and for the six-month bills is 9127945H3.
